content.value_statement: Low-quality screenshots can weaken documentation, presentations, and social posts. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code request clearer images with safer preservation steps.
actual_capabilities: Guides image quality review for resolution, sharpness, blur, and compression artifacts.
Frames enhancement requests for screenshots, photos, folders, and PNG batches.
Helps specify upscaling, sharpening, artifact reduction, and text clarity goals.
Supports output planning for web, print, presentation, and social media uses.
Encourages preserving original files while saving enhanced copies.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and prompts, not a bundled image processing engine.
Results depend on available local tools and the detail present in the source image.
It cannot restore details that are absent from the original file.
Batch work may require user review before changing many images.

use_cases.title: Clarify Documentation Screenshots
use_cases.description: Improve UI screenshots before adding them to product docs, tutorials, or release notes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Social Media Visuals
use_cases.description: Sharpen and resize images for platform-specific posts while keeping originals available.

use_cases.title: Upgrade Presentation Assets
use_cases.description: Upscale screenshots and photos so they stay readable on large screens or projectors.

prompt_templates.title: Enhance One Screenshot
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve the image quality of [filename]. Preserve the original file and save a clearly named enhanced copy.

prompt_templates.title: Sharpen Blurry Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused improvement for readable UI captures.
prompt_templates.prompt: Sharpen [filename] for text clarity. Reduce blur and avoid changing the visible UI content.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize for a Destination
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with an intended channel.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance [filename] for [web, print, presentation, or social media]. Choose a suitable size, format, and quality target.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Batch Enhance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze all PNG files in [folder]. Report quality issues first, then enhance approved files while keeping originals unchanged.

output_examples.input: Improve the image quality of screenshot-2024.png.
output: The assistant reviews resolution, blur, format, and compression quality.
It creates a sharper enhanced copy with clearer text and reduced artifacts.
The original file remains unchanged for comparison or rollback.

output_examples.input: Enhance all PNG files in the documentation images folder.
output: The assistant lists candidate images and summarizes likely improvements.
After approval, it processes selected files and keeps original versions.
The result is a folder of clearer documentation-ready screenshots.

output_examples.input: Prepare this product screenshot for a LinkedIn post.
output: The assistant adjusts the request toward platform sizing and readable details.
It prioritizes clean edges, balanced file size, and visible interface text.
The final image is ready for review before publishing.

best_practices: Keep original images unchanged until the enhanced result is reviewed.
State the target use, size, and preferred output format in the prompt.
Test one representative image before applying settings to a folder.
anti_patterns: Requesting extreme upscaling from images with very little source detail.
Batch processing a folder without backups or approval checkpoints.
Using lossy formats when small text or UI details must stay crisp.

faq.question: Does this skill include its own image processing software?
faq.answer: No. It guides the assistant to plan and request image enhancement using available tools.

faq.question: Can it improve screenshots for documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed for clearer screenshots, UI images, and documentation visuals.

faq.question: Will the original image be replaced?
faq.answer: The skill recommends preserving originals and saving enhanced copies with clear names.

faq.question: Can it process multiple images at once?
faq.answer: Yes, it includes batch workflow prompts for folders and PNG files.

faq.question: Can it recover missing details from a poor image?
faq.answer: No. It can sharpen and upscale, but it cannot recreate details that are not present.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
